description: Parity: the panel fits Settings' content. With the 10 adapters of fixtures/adapters.json (3 rows of 4), the last adapter switch lies inside the window, also while the reset confirmation adds its row, and the window stays on its display.
requirement: P2-settings-fit (GPUI Phase 2b parity, Tauri ee80e70:desktop/src/main.rs resize_panel + dist/panel.js fitWindow)
notes: The a11y dump carries no bounds, so the view reports measured layout (views/layout.rs), all in window points from one frame: view.layout.last_adapter (the last switch), view.layout.adapters_box (the grid's scroll box, which clips what it does not show) and view.layout.viewport (the window's content size). A {"path": ...} operand compares them (README, Expectations): the last switch ends inside the scroll box, and the box ends inside the window.
Tauri fitted the window to its content (clamped 96..900, capped to the display's work area, moved up rather than off the bottom). At a fixed 640x140 the grid is clipped after its first row.
Fails before the fix (on the instrumentation commits) at 'shown: the last adapter switch is fully visible (inside its scroll box, inside the window)'.
